{{Top}}
{{Quote|What an incredible smell you've discovered!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], ironically referring to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] odor after falling into a garbage chute|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Perfumes''' were fragrant substances that [[Sentience/Legends|sapient]] beings applied to themselves in order to give their bodies what they considered a pleasant scent. They were typically made from [[Plant/Legends|plants]] such as the [[jesmin]]<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> or the [[Nlorna flower perfume|nlorna flower]],<ref name="XW:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> although elements of animal origin like the scent glands of a [[tirginni beast]]<ref name="SOT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> or the costly [[Doreenian ambergris|ambergris]] vomited by the cetaceans of [[Doreen]] were also used.<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> Some perfumes were even based on the [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] produced by sentients, in order to magnify the effects of the wearer's own.<ref name="Wiz">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040105zeltros|text=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet|int=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet}}</ref> In addition to providing an attractive scent, perfumes were also used to mask bad or excessive body odors.<ref name="AB&HM">{{StoryCite|story=A Boy and His Monster: The Rancor Keeper's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> There existed perfume for every taste: they could be sweet,<ref name="droids">[[Droids (1986) 2|''Droids'' (1986) 2]]</ref> musky<ref name="Temp">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> or spicy.<ref name="XW:WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|inhabitants]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] were notably fond of perfumes and produced some of their own, which were notably sold at the [[Port Landien Perfumery]].<ref name="TM">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}</ref>
